name: powershell-windows-cli
description: PowerShell 7 / Windows PowerShell 5.1 and CMD/Batch guidance for AI agents, focused on Windows text-encoding boundaries, UTF-8/BOM, legacy CP932/936/949/950, native tools, and safe shell execution.

interface.shortDescription: Windows PowerShell and encoding-safe CLI patterns for agents
interface.longDescription: Teach agents to use PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell 5.1, CMD/Batch, and native Windows tools while preserving file encodings and handling UTF-8/BOM, CP932/936/949/950, console code pages, stdin/stdout encoding, paths, errors, and safety.
defaultPrompt: Use powershell-windows-cli for Windows shell tasks, especially when PowerShell/native tools cross text-encoding boundaries or legacy code pages.
